title: Correct row offsets
description: Automatically corrects uneven sensor rows to reduce stripes. This is separate from Column strength, which controls stripes along the other sensor axis. Rotation can make row stripes appear vertical. Usually best left on. General grain remains.
note: Shadow crop at Exposure +3 EV. Noise and Detail is off. The stripes look vertical because the photo is rotated.

variants.label: Off
variants.caption: Faint stripes run through the blue shadow.

variants.label: On
variants.caption: The stripes are reduced. The grain remains.
